name: claude
description: On-device Claude Code console: a token-gated HTTPS page for text and browser voice prompts, pointed at a persisted /workspace

variables.name: CONSOLE_TOKEN
variables.description: Access token required by the browser console. Use a long random value; anyone with it can run Claude Code in this container.

variables.name: CLAUDE_COMMAND
variables.description: Command used for one-shot Claude Code runs. The prompt is appended as the final argument.

variables.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
variables.description: Claude subscription token from `claude setup-token` on a machine with a browser. Baked into the image so Claude Code is authenticated without an in-container OAuth login.
